Note 1: The dataset is based on Date of Payment
Note 2: Any payment in the Paid amount column is made to the Billing Provider
Note 3: Due to Provider Taxonomy  Privacy concerns, paid amount of $10,000 or less have been changed to #
Note 4: Due to Patient privacy concerns, beneficiary counts less than 11 have been changed to #.
Note 5:  Amount paid includes recoupments and adjusted claims( Negative paid amounts possible)

Note 6:  The Supplemental and Settlement payments are not included in this Provider report.  They will be listed on a separate report, because they are processed outside of the Medicaid  Claims System.
Note 7:  The Reason for Unknown county code/ Name is because the Provider information has a blank under county code in NC tracks or claim come in with blank location code
Note 8: The below Dataset includes Institutional claim data for - Nursing home/Adult Care homes/Mental Health/Hospice/Inpatient  Nonacute Care/Inpatient Crossover Non Acute Care
Note 9: The recipient count is a distinct count of Members seen by provider by provider type at the rendering location along with the Billing provider information
Note 10: The Number of Patients seen for these Institutional claims can be calculated by counting the number of days stayed in the facility or hospital
Note 11: Procedures performed for Institutional claims are calculated by counting the Revenue code

Note 12: When Payer=Medicaid Direct the data source is what Medicaid paid, when Payer=Plan ID then data pertains to what each standard plan has paid as part of MCT,when Payer=LME-MCO then the data source is claims that are submitted by LME-MCO to Medicaid
